about: The cutover's manifest (untangle B24; d3 §A10): every path the cutover deletes, edits or moves, and every live object it takes down, in its three phases, so the cutover's change is: do what this lists, then delete this file. An entry is a delete (a file or a folder, whole), an edit (a file that stays, less the names it holds, each the path, identifier, key or code its text that goes is anchored to, never a sentence a wording pass may change: a name that is whole lines takes the block it heads, any other its text (ci/kit/cutover.ts edited), and less its imports: each file that goes it loads, by an import, a Python import or a path it hands a tool), a move (a file to a new home, or with names, those of it into the file that keeps them), a live object (a kind, a name, and the file that names it today), or a keep (a path left as it is although it names what goes, and why). Paths are from the repository root. ci/guards/cutover.test.ts holds it to the tree: every entry exists; the tree it leaves, every tracked file with its edits applied, names nothing it deletes but where a keep says why, and under platform/ and .github/ marks no deletion unedited and speaks none of the cutover's vocabulary; its Python compiles and binds every name, its TOML and edited YAML parse; every Python file that stays names its imports of what goes, and (the layer table's cutover layer, ci/kit/imports.ts) what is deleted may import itself while nothing that stays imports it but the imports an edit names. It is the whole cutover (the inventory, tasks.md §10 step 3; docs/decisions/untangle-2026-11/b24-manifest.md): the import window, the moves wave 2 made into the contract for the importer's sake, and every root, workflow, script, doc and spec of the old stack, with every live object; a tracked path under none of its entries stays. A move from inside a path the cutover deletes is a carry-out: a phase's moves come first, then its edits, then its deletes. Its dry run (platform/ci/dry-run.ts, run by tests.yml's cutover-dry-run jobs) applies the deletes and carry-outs, keeps what an edit loads, sets aside the tests it edits and runs the platform's suites there.
